title: Trouble-Free Discount — Comfort Club Dues on Reinstatement
content:
A Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements member whose equipment has needed little repair takes a trouble-free discount on the dues of a reinstated term. The rule reads the repair parts and repair labor lines billed on the member's calls under Repair and Emergency Service Calls.

**Trouble-free rule.** Look at the repair parts and repair labor billed on the member's service calls within the 24 months before the date of handling.
- None billed: the trouble-free discount of **3%**.
- Billed, but totalling less than the trouble-free threshold of **500.00 USD**: the low-repair discount of **1.5%**.
- Otherwise: no trouble-free discount.

Only repair parts and repair labor lines count; diagnostic fees, premiums, refrigerant and maintenance lines are not part of the total.

**Worked cases (hypothetical members)**
| Repair parts and labor billed in the 24 months | Discount |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | 3% |
| 320.00 | 1.5% |
| 499.99 | 1.5% |
| 500.00 | none |
| 1240.00 | none |
